name: alakazam_ml_v26
model: The v24 LightGBM action ranker, guarded live scope, and bounded card-ID-agnostic target ranker are byte-identical. v26 changes deterministic route accounting only.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, wins, damage, KO, prize tiers, Boss use, board-count floor, Archaludon/Grimmsnarl pressure, Dudunsparce cycles and pivots, and every non-target decision. The inherited target model contributes at most +/-800 inside deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: The v25 losses are dominated by board-count accidents rather than tactical errors, and by the one matchup that has lost across all three submissions. v26 changes only those two classes and leaves the v24/v25 skeleton intact.

v26_rule_changes: Board-count floor: at one body or fewer, any play that adds a body outranks every non-terminal action, ordered Poffin > Telepath attach > Basic > Poke Pad > Fezandipiti ex > Shaymin.
Never END the turn at one body or fewer while a body-adding option is on offer.
Refuse a Run Away Draw that shrinks the board from two bodies to one, unless it wins, completes a same-turn KO route, or the body can be replaced this turn.
Demote Hilda below Dawn when no Abra/Kadabra/Dunsparce is in play for the searched Evolution to go onto.
Detect bench snipe one evolution before it comes online and widen the survival window to three hits (four with a live Froslass), gated on two exposed bench bodies and a board of three or more.
Treat a Checkup damage-counter engine (Froslass) as a Boss role upgrade when prizes tie or favour it and at least two of our Ability Pokemon are being taxed.
preserved_v25_invariants: v24 deck, action model, target model, and guarded ML live scope
terminal Boss and terminal Active win gates
v24 ex KO route, Archaludon two-hit pressure, and low-deck pivot routes
Mist Energy Hammer memory and effect-prevention handling
Fezandipiti exposure, alternate-attacker, and Articuno-breaker logic
known_limitations: Teacher-forced comparison does not simulate the counterfactual trajectory after a changed action.
The local marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7 opponent plays the same 60 cards but is far weaker than the ladder Grimmsnarl (we win 72% locally and 29.6% on ladder), so it cannot size the real matchup gain.
The +1.9pp local Grimmsnarl gain is roughly 1.3 standard errors and is not statistically significant.
The local native battle API does not expose a fully deterministic RNG seed.
Ladder rating alone cannot rank versions; evaluate the next submission by per-archetype win rate and boardout/deckout counts.
